tldr: Virgo rising: observant, precise, and wired to improve what is in front of you.
body: With Virgo rising, you meet life through discernment, usefulness, and attention to what needs refinement. Your path asks you to serve without shrinking yourself into a list of flaws to fix.
approach: Studies the details, solves practical problems, and builds trust through competence.
shadow: Perfectionism, hypercriticism, or treating your body and life like projects that are never allowed to be complete.
note: Authored from Marie Satori Big Three and sign material.
